definitions.name: Snmp11
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 9.1: BER SNMP VarBind. Type 11 has a one-byte length; use type 64 with a two-byte length for payloads exceeding 254 octets. Vendor-specific information belongs in type 43.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NotificationReceiver
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11: notification receiver container; repeated instances describe separate receivers. Required receiver address and notification type are device processing rules, not implied by template presence.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRIPv4Address
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.1: Four-octet IPv4 notification receiver address, network byte order.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRUdpPortNumber
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.2: Two-octet UDP port; default 162 when absent.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRTrapType
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.3: Two-octet notification type: 1 SNMPv1 trap, 2 v2c trap, 3 v2c inform, 4 v3 trap, 5 v3 inform. Required when receiver is present.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRTimeout
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.4: Two-octet timeout in milliseconds; default 15000 when absent.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRRetries
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.5: Two-octet retry count; maximum value 255, default 3. Range is a device semantic constraint.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRFilteringParameters
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.6: ASN.1 universal OBJECT IDENTIFIER tag 6, BER length and encoded filter OID; default iso root when absent.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRSecurityName
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 11.1.7: SNMPv3 security name, used for notification types 4/5; absent name defaults to @mtaconfig. Provisioned keys and receiver security semantics are not validated by this registry.

definitions.name: SNMPv3NRIPv6Address
definitions.description: PKT-SP-EUE-PROV-C01-140314 section 6.5: sixteen-byte IPv6 notification receiver address in network byte order. PacketCable 2.0 only; IPv6 mode uses this instead of 38.1.

definitions.name: VendorSpecific
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 9.1 and PKT-SP-EUE-PROV-C01-140314 section 6.4.2: opaque vendor-specific payload, including vendor sub-TLV headers. PacketCable 2.0 specifies sub-option 8 as six ASCII OUI characters. Payload bytes are preserved; vendor semantics are not interpreted.

definitions.name: Snmp64
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 9.1: BER SNMP VarBind. Type 11 has a one-byte length; use type 64 with a two-byte length for payloads exceeding 254 octets. Vendor-specific information belongs in type 43.

definitions.name: TelephonyConfigFileBeginEnd
definitions.description: PKT-SP-PROV1.5-C01-191120 section 9.1; PKT-SP-EUE-PROV-C01-140314 section 6.4.2: standalone file begins with value 1 and ends with value 255. Not an embedded DOCSIS wrapper.
